title: Endless Assault
text: <keyword>Skirmish:</keyword> Discard this condition to make an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a battleground site; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; it is bearing a possession; you can spot an <symbol>urukhai</symbol> minion not assigned to a skirmish.
